title: Python Engineer (Django) - Chicago - ONSITE 2X Week- FreeWheel
description: FreeWheel provides comprehensive advertising platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers, enabling transactions across screens, data types, and sales channels. It has offices in nine countries. Its advertising buying platform powers hundreds of Demand Side Platforms (DSPs) and processes trillions of transactions to satisfy millions of dollars in advertising campaigns each month. Buyer Cloud (formerly Beeswax) builds and maintains services to set up, configure, manage, monitor, and execute DSP digital real-time bidding campaigns. The App team focuses on APIs, support tools, and ad serving systems that enable efficient and scalable programmatic advertising operations. The Backend Python Developer will design, develop, and integrate scalable solutions that meet business needs and address complex, ambiguous challenges, contributing throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, development, testing, deployment, and application integration. The role champions code quality, operational excellence, and system reliability, mentors and supports engineers, participates actively in code reviews, provides meaningful feedback, and drives engineering best practices. The title specifies onsite work twice per week in Chicago.
salary: Illinois Pay Range: $109,759.26 - $164,638.89. Comcast intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within this range, dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors such as experience.
experience: Relevant Work Experience: 5-7 Years. The ideal skillset includes 2+ years of experience working with Python and Django.
